source.text: וַיְהִ֣י אַבְרָ֔ם בֶּן־תִּשְׁעִ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה וְתֵ֣שַׁע שָׁנִ֑ים וַיֵּרָ֨א יְהוָ֜ה אֶל־אַבְרָ֗ם וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֵלָיו֙ אֲנִי־אֵ֣ל שַׁדַּ֔י הִתְהַלֵּ֥ךְ לְפָנַ֖י וֶהְיֵ֥ה תָמִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And was Abram a son of ninety years and nine years, and appeared YHWH to Abram and said to him, I [am] God Almighty; walk before me and be blameless.

en.L: When Abram was ninety-nine years old, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} appeared to Abram and said to him, "I am God Almighty; walk before {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} and be blameless,
en.B: When Abram was ninety-nine, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} appeared to him and said, "I am God Almighty. Live your life before {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} and be wholehearted,
en.R: When Abram was ninety-nine years old, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} appeared to him again. He said, "I am God Almighty. Live in a way that pleases {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, and be honest and good in everything you do.

es.L: Cuando Abram tenía noventa y nueve años, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} se apareció a Abram y le dijo: «Yo soy el Dios Todopoderoso; anda delante de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} y sé íntegro,
es.B: Cuando Abram tenía noventa y nueve años, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} se le apareció y le dijo: «Yo soy el Dios Todopoderoso. Vive delante de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} y sé íntegro de corazón,
es.R: Cuando Abram tenía noventa y nueve años, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} se le apareció otra vez y le dijo: «Yo soy el Dios Todopoderoso. Vive de una manera que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} agrade, y sé honrado y bueno en todo lo que hagas.

fr.L: Abram était âgé de quatre-vingt-dix-neuf ans, et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} apparut à Abram et lui dit : « Je suis le Dieu tout-puissant ; marche devant {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} et sois intègre,
fr.B: Quand Abram eut quatre-vingt-dix-neuf ans, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} lui apparut et lui dit : « Je suis le Dieu tout-puissant. Conduis-toi sous {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} regard et sois d’un cœur entier,
fr.R: Quand Abram avait quatre-vingt-dix-neuf ans, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} lui est de nouveau apparu. Il lui a dit : « Je suis le Dieu tout-puissant. Vis d’une manière qui {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} plaît, et sois honnête et bon dans tout ce que tu fais.

decisions.choice: God Almighty (El Shaddai): a divine name of uncertain meaning
decisions.reason: El Shaddai is a name used in Genesis for God as the giver of the promises (28:3; 35:11), and Exodus 6:3 says the patriarchs knew God by it. Its exact meaning is uncertain. "Almighty" follows the old translations; others link it to a word for mountain or explain it as "the one who is sufficient".

decisions.choice: walk before me and be blameless: live in my presence with integrity
decisions.reason: "Walk before" means to live in someone's sight, serving them. "Blameless" is the word used of Noah (6:9): whole, of complete integrity.

decisions.choice: ninety-nine years: thirteen years after Ishmael
decisions.reason: Abram was eighty-six when Ishmael was born (16:16). Thirteen years have passed with no word recorded from God.

decisions.choice: passé simple (L, B: "apparut", "dit"); passé composé (R: "est apparu", "a dit")
decisions.reason: As the French style guide sets for narrative: the passé simple is the normal tense of written narrative in a careful public reading, while Readable uses the passé composé of spoken and school French. God's speech keeps the tenses of speech at every level.

decisions.choice: "Đức Chúa Trời Toàn Năng" for El Shaddai, at every level
decisions.reason: As the Genesis terms note sets. The meaning of "Shaddai" is not certain (meaning decision, footnoted); "Toàn Năng" follows the usual reading, as "Almighty" does.

decisions.choice: God Almighty (El Shaddai) as "전능한 하나님" when God names himself, and "전능하신 하나님" when others speak of him
alternatives: "전능하신 하나님" in God's own mouth too
decisions.reason: Korean does not put the honorific on the speaker himself, so God says "나는 전능한 하나님이다"; the narrator and people use the honorific form "전능하신 하나님" set for Genesis; the same rule holds where God names himself again (35:11).

decisions.choice: o Deus Todo-Poderoso
decisions.reason: For the whole book (docs/pentateuch-portuguese-terms.md): El Shaddai is "o Deus Todo-Poderoso", following the old translations as the English "God Almighty" does; the meaning note says the sense of Shaddai is uncertain. God speaks of himself, so "mim", "me", "meu" and "minha" take the deity pronoun setting through the chapter, as in the English.

decisions.choice: sê íntegro
decisions.reason: "Íntegro" is whole and upright, the sense of the meaning note, and is the word used of Noah (6:9); "perfeito" suggests sinlessness. "Sê" is the imperative of "ser" with "tu".

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun spans in Amharic: pronouns and verb forms for God stay as they are
decisions.reason: The English offers capitalised pronouns for God as a reader setting. The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so in Amharic the setting has nothing to change; respect for God is carried by the words used of him.

decisions.choice: "ሁሉን የሚችል አምላክ" for God Almighty (El Shaddai)
decisions.reason: As in the Amharic Pentateuch: "አምላክ" for El, so that the title is not confused with the divine name "እግዚአብሔር" that stands in the same verse, and a plain description of what the title has long been taken to mean (meaning decision: its sense is uncertain).

decisions.choice: "सर्वशक्तिमान परमेश्वर"
decisions.reason: The Pentateuch note's form for El Shaddai, God Almighty, first named here; the meaning of "Shaddai" is uncertain (meaning decision m1), and Hindi follows the traditional sense, as the English does.

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans in Hindi
alternatives: deity_pronoun spans as in the English
decisions.reason: Devanagari has no capital letters, so the setting has nothing to change (style guide section 7). God's "मैं", "मेरा" and "मुझे" stand as they are; respect is carried by the honorific third person in the narrative. The same through this chapter.

decisions.choice: "Бог Всемогущий" for El Shaddai
decisions.reason: As the Pentateuch note sets; the name's first use in Genesis. Its exact meaning is uncertain (m1), and "Всемогущий" follows the long tradition of reading it.

decisions.choice: "непорочен" (L), "цельным" (B) for "tamim"
decisions.reason: The word means whole, without fault in one's dealings (m2); "совершенен" would suggest sinlessness.

decisions.choice: "Бог Всемогутній" for El Shaddai
decisions.reason: docs/ukrainian-ot-terms.md; "Вседержитель" is kept for the New Testament's pantokratōr. The same in 28:3; 35:11; 43:14; 48:3; 49:25.

decisions.choice: God Almighty (El Shaddai): "全能の神" (every level, no span)
decisions.reason: The familiar Japanese rendering of the title, as the English God Almighty; the uncertain meaning is in the English footnote (meaning decision m1). It is not the divine name, so it has no setting span.

decisions.choice: walk before me and be blameless: "わたしの前を歩み、全き者となりなさい" (L); "わたしの前に歩み、全き者でありなさい" (B); "わたしが喜ぶように生き……" (R)
decisions.reason: 全き者 is the Japanese for tamim (whole, blameless), the word used of Noah (6:9); Readable says what such a life is, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "Allah Yang Mahakuasa" for El Shaddai; "hiduplah di hadapan-{{deity_pronoun:ku|Ku}}" (L, B)
decisions.reason: "Allah Yang Mahakuasa" is the glossary form, though the meaning of the name is uncertain (m1). "walk before me" is a way of living in God's presence (m2), so "hiduplah", as for Enoch's walking (5:22).

decisions.choice: "{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}" and "{{god_term:神|上帝}}"
decisions.reason: YHWH takes the divine_name setting (上主 / 雅威) as the English spans it; every word naming the one God takes the Chinese-only god_term setting (神 / 上帝), which the English does not have. The first of each in this passage.

decisions.choice: "全能的{{god_term:神|上帝}}" (El Shaddai)
decisions.reason: The glossary's form for El Shaddai, written with 的 so that 神 and 上帝 both read well.

decisions.choice: "说：" in the same sentence
decisions.reason: The English Readable starts a new sentence with "He said"; Chinese joins it with a comma and keeps the same quotation.

decisions.choice: "Diyos na Makapangyarihan sa Lahat" (God Almighty)
decisions.reason: The glossary form for El Shaddai (m1), a divine name of uncertain meaning. "ko" and "akin" for God take no span (style guide section 4).

decisions.choice: "lumakad ka sa harap ko at maging walang kapintasan" (walk before me and be blameless) at Literal
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew "walk", a way of life lived in God's presence with integrity (m2), as in 5:22 and 6:9. Balanced says "mamuhay" (live) and "buong-puso" (wholehearted).

decisions.choice: "siyamnapu't siyam na taong gulang"

decisions.choice: I will make my covenant: grant, confirm
alternatives: I will make a new covenant
decisions.reason: The verb is "give": God gives or confirms the covenant made in chapter 15, now with its sign.

decisions.choice: my, me (deity pronoun setting)
decisions.reason: God speaks of himself, so "my" and "me" take the deity pronoun setting throughout the chapter.

decisions.choice: entre tú y yo
decisions.reason: Modern Spanish uses the subject pronouns after "entre" ("entre tú y yo"); "entre mí y ti" is archaic. God's "yo" takes no deity pronoun span, so the English span on "me" has no Spanish counterpart in this phrase; the same holds wherever "between me and you" recurs in the chapter.

decisions.choice: mi promesa
decisions.reason: As the English Readable does throughout this chapter, Readable says "promesa" for the covenant; Literal and Balanced keep "pacto".

decisions.choice: ma promesse
decisions.reason: As the English Readable does throughout this chapter, Readable says "promesse" for the covenant; Literal and Balanced keep "alliance".

decisions.choice: ahadi yangu
decisions.reason: As the English Readable does throughout this chapter, Readable says "ahadi" (promise) for the covenant; Literal and Balanced keep "agano".

decisions.choice: "giao ước" at Readable too
alternatives: "lời hứa", as the English Readable says "promise"
decisions.reason: The Genesis terms note keeps "giao ước" for covenant at every level; it is a word Vietnamese readers know, and the chapter turns on it, so Readable does not change it to "promise".

decisions.choice: "언약" kept at Readable, where the English Readable says "promise"
decisions.reason: "언약" is a common church word in Korean and the same word runs through this chapter at every level, so Readable keeps it and makes plain by the verbs ("맺은", "지키고") what kind of promise it is.

decisions.choice: "ቃል ኪዳን" for covenant at Readable too, where the English Readable says "promise"
decisions.reason: "ቃል ኪዳን" is the everyday Amharic word for a solemn pledge, a promise bound by oath, and is understood by young readers; it also keeps the link with circumcision as the sign of the covenant (verse 11), which "promise" alone would loosen.
Readable speaks of God's covenant as his promise through this chapter, as the English Readable does; Literal and Balanced keep the Pentateuch note's "वाचा".

decisions.choice: "завет" at every level, Readable included
decisions.reason: The Pentateuch note keeps "завет" for the covenant; it is a living Russian word for God's covenant, and keeping it lets the Readable reader see that this is the covenant of chapter 15.

decisions.choice: covenant: "契約" at every level, Readable too (the English Readable says "promise")
decisions.reason: 契約 is an everyday Japanese word, and keeping it at Readable lets a reader follow the one covenant through chapters 15 and 17; Readable adds 守る and 約束 where the sense is God's keeping his word.

decisions.choice: exceedingly exceedingly: "大いに、大いに" (L); "大いに" (B); "とても多くの" (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew doubling; the English deity_pronoun spans (my, me) have no Japanese span (style guide 7).

decisions.choice: "我", "我的" with no span when God speaks
decisions.reason: The English spans "my" and "me" when God speaks of himself; Chinese has no reverent first person, so God's "I", "me" and "my" are plain 我 / 我的 (style guide section 4), through this chapter.
The glossary's key term for covenant, kept through the chapter.

decisions.choice: "aking tipan" with no deity_pronoun span
decisions.reason: Tagalog "ko" and "aking" for God take no span (style guide section 4), so the English spans on "my" and "me" have no Tagalog counterpart through this chapter.

decisions.choice: "gagawin ko ang aking tipan" (I will make my covenant) at Literal, "pagtibayin" (confirm) at Balanced
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "give my covenant" means grant or confirm it (m1). "lubhang-lubha" keeps the doubled Hebrew "exceedingly exceedingly" at Literal.

am.L: «እኔ፣ እነሆ፣ ቃል ኪዳኔ ከአንተ ጋር ነው፤ አንተም ለብዙ ሕዝቦች አባት ትሆናለህ።
am.B: «ከእኔ በኩል ከአንተ ጋር ያለኝ ቃል ኪዳን ይህ ነው፦ አንተ የብዙ ሕዝቦች አባት ትሆናለህ።
am.R: «ለአንተ የምገባልህ ቃል ኪዳን ይህ ነው፦ አንተ የብዙ ሕዝቦች አባት ትሆናለህ።

hi.L: "जहाँ तक मेरी बात है, देखो, मेरी वाचा तुम्हारे साथ है, और तुम बहुत सी जातियों के पिता होगे।
hi.B: "मेरी ओर से तुम्हारे साथ मेरी वाचा यह है: तुम बहुत से देशों के पिता बनोगे।
hi.R: "तुमसे मेरी प्रतिज्ञा यह है: तुम बहुत से देशों के पिता बनोगे।

ru.L: «Я, вот, {{deity_pronoun:мой|Мой}} завет с тобой, и ты будешь отцом множества народов.
ru.B: «Вот {{deity_pronoun:мой|Мой}} завет с тобой, с {{deity_pronoun:моей|Моей}} стороны: ты станешь отцом многих народов.
ru.R: «Вот {{deity_pronoun:мой|Мой}} завет с тобой: ты будешь отцом многих народов.

uk.L: «Що ж до {{deity_pronoun:мене|Мене}}, ось {{deity_pronoun:мій|Мій}} завіт із тобою, і ти будеш батьком безлічі народів.
uk.B: «Ось {{deity_pronoun:мій|Мій}} завіт із тобою, з {{deity_pronoun:мого|Мого}} боку: ти станеш батьком багатьох народів.
uk.R: «Ось {{deity_pronoun:моя|Моя}} обіцянка тобі: ти будеш батьком багатьох народів.

ja.L: 「わたしについては、見なさい、わたしの契約はあなたと共にある。あなたは多くの国民の父となる。
ja.B: 「わたしの側からの、あなたとの契約はこうである。あなたは多くの国民の父となる。
ja.R: 「これが、あなたとの契約である。あなたは多くの国民の父となる。

id.L: "Dari pihak-{{deity_pronoun:ku|Ku}}, lihatlah, perjanjian-{{deity_pronoun:ku|Ku}} ada dengan engkau, dan engkau akan menjadi bapa sejumlah besar bangsa.
id.B: "Dari pihak-{{deity_pronoun:ku|Ku}}, inilah perjanjian-{{deity_pronoun:ku|Ku}} dengan engkau: engkau akan menjadi bapa banyak bangsa.
id.R: "Inilah perjanjian-{{deity_pronoun:ku|Ku}} dengan kamu: kamu akan menjadi bapa banyak bangsa.

zh.L: “至于我，看哪，我的约是与你立的，你要作多国的父。
zh.B: “从我这方面说，这就是我与你立的约：你要成为多国的父亲。
zh.R: “这是我与你立的盟约：你要成为许多民族的父亲。

tl.L: "Para sa akin, narito, ang aking tipan ay sa iyo, at ikaw ay magiging ama ng napakaraming bansa.
tl.B: "Ito ang aking tipan sa iyo, mula sa aking panig: ikaw ay magiging ama ng maraming bansa.
tl.R: "Ito ang aking tipan sa iyo: ikaw ay magiging ama ng maraming bansa.

decisions.choice: the father of a multitude of nations: more than one people
decisions.reason: Abraham will be father of Israel, of Ishmael's and Esau's peoples, and of the children of Keturah (25:1-4). Paul reads the promise as fulfilled in all who share Abraham's faith (Romans 4:16-17).

decisions.choice: "बहुत सी जातियों" (L); "बहुत से देशों" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The forms of Romans 4:17-18, which quotes this promise: Literal "जातियाँ"; Balanced and Readable "देश", since "जाति" also means caste. The same in 17:5-6 and 17:16.

decisions.choice: "ama ng napakaraming bansa" (father of a multitude of nations)
decisions.reason: More than one people will come from Abraham (m1). "bansa" is the glossary word for a nation.

source.text: וְלֹא־יִקָּרֵ֥א ע֛וֹד אֶת־שִׁמְךָ֖ אַבְרָ֑ם וְהָיָ֤ה שִׁמְךָ֙ אַבְרָהָ֔ם כִּ֛י אַב־הֲמ֥וֹן גּוֹיִ֖ם נְתַתִּֽיךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: And not will be called again your name Abram, and will be your name Abraham, for [the] father of a multitude of nations I have made you.

en.L: No longer shall your name be called Abram, but your name shall be Abraham, for I have made you the father of a multitude of nations.
en.B: Your name will no longer be Abram. From now on it is Abraham, since I have made you a father of many nations.
en.R: Your name will not be Abram anymore. It will be Abraham, because I have made you the father of many nations.

es.L: Y no se llamará más tu nombre Abram, sino que tu nombre será Abraham, porque padre de una multitud de naciones te he hecho.
es.B: Ya no te llamarás Abram. De ahora en adelante tu nombre es Abraham, porque te he hecho padre de muchas naciones.
es.R: Ya no te vas a llamar Abram. Te llamarás Abraham, porque te he hecho padre de muchas naciones.

fr.L: Et on n’appellera plus ton nom Abram, mais ton nom sera Abraham, car je t’ai fait père d’une multitude de nations.
fr.B: Tu ne t’appelleras plus Abram. Désormais ton nom est Abraham, car j’ai fait de toi le père de nombreuses nations.
fr.R: Tu ne t’appelleras plus Abram. Tu t’appelleras Abraham, parce que j’ai fait de toi le père de beaucoup de nations.

sw.L: Wala jina lako halitaitwa tena Abramu, bali jina lako litakuwa Abrahamu, kwa maana nimekufanya baba wa umati wa mataifa.
sw.B: Jina lako halitakuwa tena Abramu. Tangu sasa utaitwa Abrahamu, kwa kuwa nimekufanya baba wa mataifa mengi.
sw.R: Hutaitwa Abramu tena. Utaitwa Abrahamu, kwa sababu nimekufanya kuwa baba wa mataifa mengi.

vi.L: Tên con sẽ không còn gọi là Áp-ram nữa, nhưng tên con sẽ là Áp-ra-ham, vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã lập con làm cha của vô số dân tộc.
vi.B: Tên con sẽ không còn là Áp-ram nữa. Từ nay tên con là Áp-ra-ham, vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã lập con làm cha của nhiều dân tộc.
vi.R: Con sẽ không còn tên là Áp-ram nữa. Con sẽ tên là Áp-ra-ham, vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã làm cho con trở thành cha của nhiều dân tộc.

ko.L: 다시는 네 이름을 아브람이라고 부르지 않을 것이다. 네 이름은 아브라함이 될 것이다. 내가 너를 많은 민족의 아버지로 만들었기 때문이다.
ko.B: 이제부터 네 이름은 아브람이 아니라 아브라함이다. 내가 너를 많은 민족의 아버지로 삼았기 때문이다.
ko.R: 이제 네 이름은 아브람이 아니다. 아브라함이다. 내가 너를 많은 민족의 조상으로 삼았기 때문이다.

pt.L: Não se chamará mais o teu nome Abrão, mas o teu nome será Abraão, porque eu te fiz pai de uma multidão de nações.
pt.B: O teu nome não será mais Abrão. De agora em diante será Abraão, porque eu te fiz pai de muitas nações.
pt.R: O teu nome não vai mais ser Abrão. Vai ser Abraão, porque eu te fiz o pai de muitas nações.

am.L: ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ ስምህ አብራም ተብሎ አይጠራም፤ ነገር ግን ስምህ አብርሃም ይሆናል፤ ለብዙ ሕዝቦች አባት አድርጌሃለሁና።
am.B: ከእንግዲህ ስምህ አብራም አይሆንም። ከአሁን ጀምሮ ስምህ አብርሃም ነው፤ ለብዙ ሕዝቦች አባት አድርጌሃለሁና።
am.R: ከእንግዲህ ስምህ አብራም አይባልም። አብርሃም ይባላል፤ ምክንያቱም ለብዙ ሕዝቦች አባት አድርጌሃለሁ።

hi.L: और तुम्हारा नाम फिर अब्राम नहीं कहलाएगा, पर तुम्हारा नाम अब्राहम होगा, क्योंकि मैंने तुम्हें बहुत सी जातियों का पिता ठहराया है।
hi.B: अब तुम्हारा नाम अब्राम नहीं रहेगा। अब से तुम्हारा नाम अब्राहम है, क्योंकि मैंने तुम्हें बहुत से देशों का पिता बनाया है।
hi.R: अब तुम्हारा नाम अब्राम नहीं रहेगा। तुम्हारा नाम अब्राहम होगा, क्योंकि मैंने तुम्हें बहुत से देशों का पिता बनाया है।

ru.L: И не будет больше называться твоё имя Аврам, но будет твоё имя Авраам, потому что {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} сделал тебя отцом множества народов.
ru.B: Тебя больше не будут звать Аврам. Отныне твоё имя Авраам, потому что {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} сделал тебя отцом многих народов.
ru.R: Тебя больше не будут звать Аврамом. Тебя будут звать Авраамом, потому что {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} сделал тебя отцом многих народов.

uk.L: І не буде більше твоє імʼя називатися Аврам, а буде твоє імʼя Авраам, бо батьком безлічі народів {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} зробив тебе.
uk.B: Твоє імʼя більше не буде Аврам. Відтепер воно — Авраам, бо {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} зробив тебе батьком багатьох народів.
uk.R: Тебе більше не зватимуть Аврам. Твоє імʼя буде Авраам, бо {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} зробив тебе батьком багатьох народів.

ja.L: あなたの名はもはやアブラムと呼ばれず、あなたの名はアブラハムとなる。わたしがあなたを多くの国民の父としたからである。
ja.B: あなたの名は、もはやアブラムではない。今からはアブラハムである。わたしがあなたを多くの国民の父としたからである。
ja.R: あなたの名前は、もうアブラムではない。アブラハムとなる。わたしがあなたを多くの国民の父にしたからだ。

id.L: Namamu tidak akan disebut Abram lagi, tetapi namamu akan menjadi Abraham, sebab {{deity_pronoun:aku|Aku}} telah menjadikan engkau bapa sejumlah besar bangsa.
id.B: Namamu tidak akan lagi Abram. Mulai sekarang namamu Abraham, sebab {{deity_pronoun:aku|Aku}} telah menjadikan engkau bapa banyak bangsa.
id.R: Namamu tidak akan lagi Abram. Namamu akan menjadi Abraham, karena {{deity_pronoun:aku|Aku}} telah menjadikan kamu bapa banyak bangsa.

zh.L: 人不再称你的名为亚伯兰，你的名要成为亚伯拉罕，因为我已经立你作多国的父。
zh.B: 你的名字不再是亚伯兰。从现在起，你的名字是亚伯拉罕，因为我已经立你作多国的父亲。
zh.R: 你不再叫亚伯兰了。你要叫亚伯拉罕，因为我已经立你作许多民族的父亲。

tl.L: Hindi na tatawagin ang iyong pangalan na Abram, kundi ang iyong pangalan ay magiging Abraham, sapagkat ginawa kitang ama ng napakaraming bansa.
tl.B: Hindi na Abram ang iyong pangalan. Mula ngayon ay Abraham na, sapagkat ginawa kitang ama ng maraming bansa.
tl.R: Hindi na Abram ang itatawag sa iyo. Abraham na ang iyong pangalan, sapagkat ginawa kitang ama ng maraming bansa.

decisions.choice: Abram ... Abraham: "exalted father" ... "father of a multitude"
decisions.reason: Abram means "exalted father". Abraham is explained by its sound: av hamon, "father of a multitude". A new name marks a new calling, given by God (32:28).

decisions.choice: I have made you: as good as done
decisions.reason: The completed form announces God's promise as already settled, though Abraham has as yet one son.

decisions.choice: "Áp-ram" and "Áp-ra-ham", with the meanings in a footnote
alternatives: "Áp-ram" with the meaning in the text
decisions.reason: As the English, the names stay as they are. In Hebrew "Abram" sounds like "exalted father" and "Abraham" like "father of a multitude" (meaning decision); the footnote gives this so the reader hears why God says "vì".

decisions.choice: "아브라함" explained by the reason that follows; Readable says "조상" (ancestor) for father
alternatives: an added note on what each name means
decisions.reason: The Hebrew gives the reason for the new name in the same breath, and Korean keeps it as the verse's last clause so a reader hears the link between "아브라함" and "많은 민족의 아버지"; the meaning of both names is in the meaning decision and its footnote.

decisions.choice: Abrão ... Abraão
decisions.reason: For the whole book (docs/pentateuch-portuguese-terms.md): "Abrão" until here, "Abraão" from now on. The Portuguese forms, like the Hebrew, differ by one added syllable, so the change is visible; the meaning note explains the sound-play "father of a multitude". The words "eu te fiz pai de muitas nações" agree with the Portuguese of Romans 4:17.

decisions.choice: "አብርሃም" from here on (before, "አብራም"); "ለብዙ ሕዝቦች አባት አድርጌሃለሁ" as in the Amharic of Romans 4:17
alternatives: "አብራም" kept to the end of the chapter
decisions.reason: The new name begins where God gives it, as in the Hebrew. Paul quotes this line in Romans 4:17, and the Greek agrees with the Hebrew, so the Amharic keeps the New Testament's words.

decisions.choice: "मैंने तुम्हें बहुत सी जातियों का पिता ठहराया है" (L); "... बहुत से देशों का पिता बनाया है" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The words of Romans 4:17 at each level, where Paul quotes this verse.

decisions.choice: "Аврам" and "Авраам"
decisions.reason: The traditional Russian forms, and the New Testament's "Авраам"; the new name is longer by a letter, as in the Hebrew.

decisions.choice: "Аврам ... Авраам", with the meaning left to the note
decisions.reason: The change of name is kept visible as the Hebrew has it; from here on he is "Авраам" (docs/ukrainian-ot-terms.md).

decisions.choice: Abraham "アブラハム" from here on
decisions.reason: The NT form; the change of name is kept visible at every level, Abram before 17:5 and Abraham after.

decisions.choice: "我已经立你作多国的父" (L), "……多国的父亲" (B), "……许多民族的父亲" (R)
decisions.reason: Romans 4:17 quotes this clause and the Hebrew says the same; each level keeps the Chinese of Romans 4:17 at that level, and verse 4 uses the same words.

decisions.choice: "亚伯兰" to "亚伯拉罕"
decisions.reason: The two names kept apart from here on, as the glossary has them; the change of name is the point of the verse.

decisions.choice: "Abram", "Abraham" (glossary)
decisions.reason: The glossary forms. The meanings "exalted father" and "father of a multitude" (m1) are left to the meaning decision.

decisions.choice: "ginawa kita" (I have made you)
decisions.reason: The completed form shows a promise as good as done (m2).

source.text: וְהִפְרֵתִ֤י אֹֽתְךָ֙ בִּמְאֹ֣ד מְאֹ֔ד וּנְתַתִּ֖יךָ לְגוֹיִ֑ם וּמְלָכִ֖ים מִמְּךָ֥ יֵצֵֽאוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And I will make you fruitful exceedingly exceedingly, and I will make you into nations, and kings from you will come out.

en.L: I will make you exceedingly fruitful, and I will make nations of you, and kings shall come from you.
en.B: I will make you abundantly fruitful; nations will come from you, and kings will be among your descendants.
en.R: I will give you many, many descendants. They will become nations, and some of them will be kings.

es.L: Y te haré fructificar muchísimo, y te convertiré en naciones, y reyes saldrán de ti.
es.B: Te haré muy fecundo; de ti saldrán naciones, y entre tus descendientes habrá reyes.
es.R: Te daré muchísimos descendientes. Llegarán a ser naciones, y algunos de ellos serán reyes.

fr.L: Et je te rendrai fécond extrêmement, et je ferai de toi des nations, et des rois sortiront de toi.
fr.B: Je te rendrai très fécond : des nations naîtront de toi, et des rois compteront parmi tes descendants.
fr.R: Je te donnerai beaucoup, beaucoup de descendants. Ils deviendront des nations, et certains d’entre eux seront rois.

sw.L: Nami nitakufanya uzae sana sana, {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitakufanya kuwa mataifa, na wafalme watatoka kwako.
sw.B: Nitakufanya uzae kwa wingi; mataifa yatatoka kwako, na wafalme watakuwa miongoni mwa wazao wako.
sw.R: Nitakupa wazao wengi mno. Watakuwa mataifa, na baadhi yao watakuwa wafalme.

vi.L: Ta sẽ làm cho con sinh sôi nảy nở thật nhiều; {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ làm cho con thành các dân tộc, và các vua sẽ ra từ con.
vi.B: Ta sẽ làm cho con sinh sôi nảy nở dồi dào; các dân tộc sẽ ra từ con, và trong dòng dõi con sẽ có các vua.
vi.R: Ta sẽ cho con rất, rất nhiều con cháu. Họ sẽ trở thành các dân tộc, và một số người trong họ sẽ làm vua.

ko.L: 내가 너를 매우 매우 번성하게 하여 너에게서 민족들이 나오게 하고, 왕들이 너에게서 나올 것이다.
ko.B: 내가 너를 크게 번성하게 하겠다. 너에게서 여러 민족이 나오고, 네 자손 가운데에서 왕들이 나올 것이다.
ko.R: 내가 너에게 아주 많은 자손을 주겠다. 그들이 여러 민족을 이루고, 그 가운데에서 왕들도 나올 것이다.

pt.L: E te farei frutificar muitíssimo, e de ti farei nações, e reis sairão de ti.
pt.B: Eu te farei muito fecundo; de ti sairão nações, e reis estarão entre os teus descendentes.
pt.R: Eu vou te dar muitos e muitos descendentes. Eles vão formar nações, e alguns deles vão ser reis.

am.L: እጅግ እጅግም ፍሬያማ አደርግሃለሁ፤ ሕዝቦችም አደርግሃለሁ፤ ነገሥታትም ከአንተ ይወጣሉ።
am.B: እጅግ አበዛሃለሁ፤ ከአንተ ሕዝቦች ይወጣሉ፤ ከዘሮችህም መካከል ነገሥታት ይነሣሉ።
am.R: እጅግ በጣም ብዙ ዘሮች እሰጥሃለሁ። ሕዝቦች ይሆናሉ፤ ከእነርሱም አንዳንዶቹ ነገሥታት ይሆናሉ።

hi.L: मैं तुम्हें बहुत ही अधिक फलवन्त करूँगा, और तुमसे जातियाँ बनाऊँगा, और तुमसे राजा निकलेंगे।
hi.B: मैं तुम्हें बहुत फलवन्त करूँगा; तुमसे देश निकलेंगे, और तुम्हारे वंशजों में राजा होंगे।
hi.R: मैं तुम्हें बहुत, बहुत से वंशज दूँगा। वे देश बनेंगे, और उनमें से कुछ राजा होंगे।

ru.L: И {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} сделаю тебя плодовитым весьма, весьма, и сделаю тебя народами, и цари от тебя произойдут.
ru.B: Я дам тебе обильное потомство; от тебя произойдут народы, и среди твоих потомков будут цари.
ru.R: Я дам тебе очень, очень много потомков. Они станут народами, и некоторые из них будут царями.

uk.L: І {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} дуже-дуже розплоджу тебе, і зроблю з тебе народи, і царі вийдуть із тебе.
uk.B: Я дам тобі дуже багато потомства; від тебе постануть народи, і серед твоїх нащадків будуть царі.
uk.R: Я дам тобі дуже, дуже багато нащадків. Вони стануть народами, і деякі з них будуть царями.

ja.L: わたしはあなたを大いに、大いに実り豊かにし、あなたを国民とする。そして王たちがあなたから出る。
ja.B: わたしはあなたに豊かに子孫を与え、あなたから多くの国民が出るようにする。王たちも、あなたの子孫から出る。
ja.R: わたしはあなたに、とてもたくさんの子孫を与える。子孫は国民となり、その中から王も出る。

id.L: Aku akan membuat engkau sangat berbuah, dan {{deity_pronoun:aku|Aku}} akan membuat engkau menjadi bangsa-bangsa, dan raja-raja akan keluar dari padamu.
id.B: Aku akan membuat engkau beranak cucu sangat banyak; bangsa-bangsa akan berasal dari padamu, dan raja-raja akan ada di antara keturunanmu.
id.R: Aku akan memberimu sangat, sangat banyak keturunan. Mereka akan menjadi bangsa-bangsa, dan sebagian dari mereka akan menjadi raja.

zh.L: 我要使你极其极其繁衍，使你成为[许多]国，君王要从你而出。
zh.B: 我要使你子孙繁盛，从你要兴起许多国家，君王也要出在你的后代中。
zh.R: 我要给你很多很多后代。他们要成为许多国家，其中有些人要作王。

tl.L: Gagawin kitang lubhang-lubhang palaanakin, at gagawa ako ng mga bansa mula sa iyo, at mga hari ang magmumula sa iyo.
tl.B: Gagawin kitang lubhang palaanakin; mga bansa ang magmumula sa iyo, at mga hari ang mapapabilang sa iyong mga inapo.
tl.R: Bibigyan kita ng napakarami, napakaraming inapo. Magiging mga bansa sila, at ang ilan sa kanila ay magiging mga hari.

decisions.choice: kings shall come from you: the kings of Israel
decisions.reason: The promise of kings looks ahead to Israel's kings, above all David (2 Samuel 7:12).

decisions.choice: "mga hari ang magmumula sa iyo" (kings shall come from you)
decisions.reason: The kings of Israel (m1). "palaanakin" is the root of the blessing of 1:28, "Magpalaanakin kayo".

source.text: וַהֲקִמֹתִ֨י אֶת־בְּרִיתִ֜י בֵּינִ֣י וּבֵינֶ֗ךָ וּבֵ֨ין זַרְעֲךָ֧ אַחֲרֶ֛יךָ לְדֹרֹתָ֖ם לִבְרִ֣ית עוֹלָ֑ם לִהְי֤וֹת לְךָ֙ לֵֽאלֹהִ֔ים וּֽלְזַרְעֲךָ֖ אַחֲרֶֽיךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: And I will establish my covenant between me and you and your offspring after you for their generations, for an everlasting covenant, to be to you God and to your offspring after you.

en.L: And I will establish {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} covenant between {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} and you and your offspring after you throughout their generations, an everlasting covenant, to be God to you and to your offspring after you.
en.B: I will keep {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} covenant with you and your descendants after you for generations to come, as an everlasting covenant: I will be your God and the God of your descendants after you.
en.R: My covenant with you and your descendants will last forever. I will be your God, and the God of all your descendants after you.

es.L: Y estableceré {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pacto entre tú y yo y tu descendencia después de ti, por sus generaciones, como pacto perpetuo, para ser Dios para ti y para tu descendencia después de ti.
es.B: Mantendré {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pacto contigo y con tus descendientes después de ti, de generación en generación, como un pacto eterno: yo seré tu Dios y el Dios de tus descendientes después de ti.
es.R: Mi promesa para ti y para tus descendientes durará para siempre. Yo seré tu Dios, y el Dios de todos tus descendientes después de ti.

fr.L: Et j’établirai {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} alliance entre {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} et toi et ta descendance après toi, au long de leurs générations, en alliance perpétuelle, pour être Dieu pour toi et pour ta descendance après toi.
fr.B: Je maintiendrai {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} alliance avec toi et avec tes descendants après toi, de génération en génération, comme une alliance éternelle : je serai ton Dieu et le Dieu de tes descendants après toi.
fr.R: Ma promesse pour toi et pour tes descendants durera toujours. Je serai ton Dieu, et le Dieu de tous tes descendants après toi.

sw.L: Nami nitalisimamisha agano {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}} kati {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} na wewe na uzao wako baada yako katika vizazi vyao, kuwa agano la milele, ili niwe Mungu kwako na kwa uzao wako baada yako.
sw.B: Nitalidumisha agano {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}} nawe na wazao wako baada yako, kizazi hata kizazi, kuwa agano la milele: nitakuwa Mungu wako na Mungu wa wazao wako baada yako.
sw.R: Ahadi {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} kwako na kwa wazao wako itadumu milele. Nitakuwa Mungu wako, na Mungu wa wazao wako wote baada yako.

vi.L: Ta sẽ lập giao ước của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} giữa {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} và con, và dòng dõi con sau con, qua các thế hệ của họ, làm giao ước đời đời, để {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} làm Đức Chúa Trời của con và của dòng dõi con sau con.
vi.B: Ta sẽ giữ giao ước của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} với con và với dòng dõi con sau con, từ đời này sang đời kia, làm giao ước đời đời: {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ là Đức Chúa Trời của con và của dòng dõi con sau con.
vi.R: Giao ước của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} với con và con cháu con sẽ còn mãi mãi. Ta sẽ là Đức Chúa Trời của con, và là Đức Chúa Trời của mọi con cháu con sau này.

ko.L: 그리고 내가 나와 너와 네 뒤에 오는 네 씨 사이에 내 언약을 그들의 대대로 세워 영원한 언약으로 삼고, 너와 네 뒤에 오는 네 씨에게 하나님이 되겠다.
ko.B: 내가 나와 너 사이에, 그리고 네 뒤를 이을 자손 사이에 대대로 내 언약을 세워 영원한 언약으로 삼겠다. 나는 너의 하나님이 되고, 네 뒤를 이을 자손의 하나님이 될 것이다.
ko.R: 내가 너와 네 자손과 맺은 언약은 영원히 이어질 것이다. 나는 너의 하나님이 되고, 네 뒤에 올 모든 자손의 하나님이 될 것이다.

pt.L: E estabelecerei a {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} aliança entre {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}} e ti e a tua descendência depois de ti, através das suas gerações, como aliança eterna, para ser Deus para ti e para a tua descendência depois de ti.
pt.B: Manterei a {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} aliança contigo e com os teus descendentes depois de ti, por todas as gerações, como aliança eterna: eu serei o teu Deus e o Deus dos teus descendentes depois de ti.
pt.R: A {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} promessa a ti e aos teus descendentes vai durar para sempre. Eu vou ser o teu Deus e o Deus de todos os teus descendentes depois de ti.

am.L: ለአንተና ከአንተ በኋላ ለዘርህ አምላክ እሆን ዘንድ ቃል ኪዳኔን በእኔና በአንተ መካከል፣ ከአንተም በኋላ በዘርህ መካከል በትውልዳቸው ሁሉ የዘላለም ቃል ኪዳን አድርጌ አጸናለሁ።
am.B: ቃል ኪዳኔን ከአንተና ከአንተ በኋላ ከሚመጣው ዘርህ ጋር ለሚመጡት ትውልዶች ሁሉ የዘላለም ቃል ኪዳን አድርጌ እጠብቃለሁ፤ እኔ አምላክህና ከአንተ በኋላ የሚመጣው የዘርህ አምላክ እሆናለሁ።
am.R: ከአንተና ከዘሮችህ ጋር ያለኝ ቃል ኪዳን ለዘላለም ይኖራል። እኔ አምላክህ እሆናለሁ፤ ከአንተ በኋላ የሚመጡት የዘሮችህ ሁሉ አምላክም እሆናለሁ።

hi.L: और मैं अपने और तुम्हारे बीच, और तुम्हारे बाद तुम्हारे वंश के बीच, उनकी पीढ़ी-पीढ़ी में, अपनी वाचा स्थापित करूँगा, एक सदा की वाचा, कि मैं तुम्हारा और तुम्हारे बाद तुम्हारे वंश का परमेश्वर रहूँ।
hi.B: मैं तुम्हारे साथ और तुम्हारे बाद तुम्हारे वंशजों के साथ पीढ़ी-पीढ़ी तक अपनी वाचा बनाए रखूँगा, एक सदा की वाचा के रूप में: मैं तुम्हारा परमेश्वर रहूँगा, और तुम्हारे बाद तुम्हारे वंशजों का भी परमेश्वर रहूँगा।
hi.R: तुमसे और तुम्हारे वंशजों से मेरी यह प्रतिज्ञा सदा बनी रहेगी। मैं तुम्हारा परमेश्वर रहूँगा, और तुम्हारे बाद तुम्हारे सब वंशजों का भी परमेश्वर रहूँगा।

ru.L: И {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} поставлю {{deity_pronoun:мой|Мой}} завет между {{deity_pronoun:мной|Мной}} и тобой и твоим семенем после тебя в их поколениях заветом вечным, чтобы быть Богом тебе и твоему семени после тебя.
ru.B: Я буду хранить {{deity_pronoun:мой|Мой}} завет с тобой и с твоими потомками после тебя во всех их поколениях как вечный завет: Я буду твоим Богом и Богом твоих потомков после тебя.
ru.R: Мой завет с тобой и с твоими потомками будет вечным. Я буду твоим Богом и Богом всех твоих потомков после тебя.

uk.L: І {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} встановлю {{deity_pronoun:мій|Мій}} завіт між {{deity_pronoun:мною|Мною}} і тобою, і твоїм потомством після тебе в їхніх поколіннях, як вічний завіт, щоб бути Богом тобі й твоєму потомству після тебе.
uk.B: Я дотримаю {{deity_pronoun:мого|Мого}} завіту з тобою і з твоїми нащадками після тебе в усіх майбутніх поколіннях як вічного завіту: {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} буду твоїм Богом і Богом твоїх нащадків після тебе.
uk.R: Моя обіцянка тобі й твоїм нащадкам триватиме вічно. Я буду твоїм Богом і Богом усіх твоїх нащадків після тебе.

ja.L: そしてわたしは、わたしとあなたとの間に、またあなたの後の子孫との間に、彼らの代々にわたって、わたしの契約を永遠の契約として立てる。あなたの神となり、あなたの後の子孫の神となるためである。
ja.B: わたしは、わたしとあなたとの間に、また後に続くあなたの子孫との間に、代々にわたってわたしの契約を永遠の契約として守る。わたしはあなたの神となり、後に続くあなたの子孫の神となる。
ja.R: あなたとあなたの子孫とのわたしの契約は、いつまでも続く。わたしはあなたの神となり、あなたの後に続くすべての子孫の神となる。

id.L: Dan {{deity_pronoun:aku|Aku}} akan meneguhkan perjanjian-{{deity_pronoun:ku|Ku}} antara {{deity_pronoun:aku|Aku}} dan engkau dan keturunanmu sesudah engkau turun-temurun, menjadi perjanjian yang kekal, supaya {{deity_pronoun:aku|Aku}} menjadi Allahmu dan Allah keturunanmu sesudah engkau.
id.B: Aku akan meneguhkan perjanjian-{{deity_pronoun:ku|Ku}} dengan engkau dan keturunanmu sesudah engkau turun-temurun, sebagai perjanjian yang kekal: {{deity_pronoun:aku|Aku}} akan menjadi Allahmu dan Allah keturunanmu sesudah engkau.
id.R: Perjanjian-{{deity_pronoun:ku|Ku}} dengan kamu dan keturunanmu akan berlaku untuk selama-lamanya. Aku akan menjadi Allahmu, dan Allah semua keturunanmu sesudah kamu.

zh.L: 我要在我与你、以及你以后的后裔之间，世世代代确立我的约，作为永远的约，要作你和你以后后裔的{{god_term:神|上帝}}。
zh.B: 我要与你和你以后世世代代的后代守我的约，作为永远的约：我要作你的{{god_term:神|上帝}}，也作你以后后代的{{god_term:神|上帝}}。
zh.R: 我与你和你后代立的盟约要永远长存。我要作你的{{god_term:神|上帝}}，也作你以后所有后代的{{god_term:神|上帝}}。

tl.L: At itatatag ko ang aking tipan sa pagitan ko at mo at ng iyong binhi pagkatapos mo sa kanilang mga salinlahi, isang walang hanggang tipan, upang maging Diyos mo at ng iyong binhi pagkatapos mo.
tl.B: Tutuparin ko ang aking tipan sa iyo at sa iyong mga inapo pagkatapos mo sa mga salinlahing darating, bilang walang hanggang tipan: ako ang magiging Diyos mo at ang Diyos ng iyong mga inapo pagkatapos mo.
tl.R: Mananatili magpakailanman ang aking tipan sa iyo at sa iyong mga inapo. Ako ang magiging Diyos mo, at ang Diyos ng lahat ng iyong mga inapo pagkatapos mo.

decisions.choice: to be God to you and to your offspring: the heart of the covenant
decisions.reason: The promise "I will be your God" is the center of every covenant God makes with his people (Exodus 6:7; Jeremiah 31:33; Revelation 21:3).

decisions.choice: everlasting covenant: "永遠の契約" (L, B); "いつまでも続く" (R)
decisions.reason: 永遠 as in 永遠の命; Readable uses the everyday phrase, as 13:15 has いつまでも.

decisions.choice: "upang maging Diyos mo" (to be your God); "walang hanggang tipan" (everlasting covenant)
decisions.reason: The heart of the covenant (m1). "walang hanggan" is the key-term word for everlasting, as in 9:16.

alignments.target_span: わたしとあなたとの間に
あなたの子孫との間に

source.text: וְנָתַתִּ֣י לְ֠ךָ וּלְזַרְעֲךָ֨ אַחֲרֶ֜יךָ אֵ֣ת׀אֶ֣רֶץ מְגֻרֶ֗יךָ אֵ֚ת כָּל־אֶ֣רֶץ כְּנַ֔עַן לַאֲחֻזַּ֖ת עוֹלָ֑ם וְהָיִ֥יתִי לָהֶ֖ם לֵאלֹהִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And I will give to you and to your offspring after you [the] land of your sojournings, all [the] land of Canaan, for a possession everlasting; and I will be to them God.

en.L: And I will give to you and to your offspring after you the land of your sojournings, all the land of Canaan, as an everlasting possession; and I will be their God."
en.B: I will give you and your descendants after you all the land of Canaan, the land where you are now a foreigner, to hold for all time, and I will be their God."
en.R: I will give you and your descendants all the land of Canaan, where you are now living as a stranger. It will be theirs forever, and I will be their God."

es.L: Y te daré a ti y a tu descendencia después de ti la tierra de tus peregrinaciones, toda la tierra de Canaán, en posesión perpetua; y seré su Dios».
es.B: A ti y a tus descendientes después de ti les daré toda la tierra de Canaán, la tierra donde ahora vives como extranjero, para que sea suya para siempre, y yo seré su Dios».
es.R: Te daré a ti y a tus descendientes toda la tierra de Canaán, donde ahora vives como extranjero. Será de ellos para siempre, y yo seré su Dios».

fr.L: Et je te donnerai, à toi et à ta descendance après toi, le pays de tes séjours d’étranger, tout le pays de Canaan, en possession perpétuelle ; et je serai leur Dieu. »
fr.B: Je te donnerai, à toi et à tes descendants après toi, tout le pays de Canaan, le pays où tu vis aujourd’hui en étranger, pour qu’ils le possèdent à jamais, et je serai leur Dieu. »
fr.R: Je te donnerai, à toi et à tes descendants, tout le pays de Canaan, où tu vis maintenant comme un étranger. Il sera à eux pour toujours, et je serai leur Dieu. »

sw.L: Nami nitakupa wewe na uzao wako baada yako nchi ya ugeni wako, nchi yote ya Kanaani, kuwa milki ya milele; {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitakuwa Mungu wao."
sw.B: Nitakupa wewe na wazao wako baada yako nchi yote ya Kanaani, nchi unamoishi sasa kama mgeni, iwe yao daima, {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitakuwa Mungu wao."
sw.R: Nitakupa wewe na wazao wako nchi yote ya Kanaani, unakoishi sasa kama mgeni. Itakuwa yao milele, {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitakuwa Mungu wao."

vi.L: Ta sẽ ban cho con và cho dòng dõi con sau con xứ con đang làm kiều dân, là cả xứ Ca-na-an, làm sản nghiệp đời đời; và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ là Đức Chúa Trời của họ."
vi.B: Ta sẽ ban cho con và dòng dõi con sau con cả xứ Ca-na-an, là xứ mà bây giờ con đang sống như người ngoại kiều, để làm sản nghiệp mãi mãi, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ là Đức Chúa Trời của họ."
vi.R: Ta sẽ ban cho con và con cháu con cả xứ Ca-na-an, là nơi bây giờ con đang sống như một người khách lạ. Xứ ấy sẽ thuộc về họ mãi mãi, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ là Đức Chúa Trời của họ."

ko.L: 그리고 내가 너와 네 뒤에 오는 네 씨에게 네가 나그네로 사는 땅, 곧 가나안 온 땅을 영원한 소유로 주고, 나는 그들의 하나님이 되겠다."
ko.B: 지금 네가 나그네로 살고 있는 이 가나안 온 땅을 너와 네 뒤를 이을 자손에게 영원한 소유로 주겠다. 그리고 나는 그들의 하나님이 될 것이다."
ko.R: 지금 네가 나그네로 살고 있는 가나안 땅을 모두 너와 네 자손에게 주겠다. 그 땅은 영원히 그들의 것이 될 것이다. 그리고 나는 그들의 하나님이 될 것이다."

pt.L: E darei a ti e à tua descendência depois de ti a terra das tuas peregrinações, toda a terra de Canaã, como possessão eterna; e serei o Deus deles."
pt.B: Darei a ti e aos teus descendentes depois de ti toda a terra de Canaã, onde agora vives como estrangeiro, para que seja deles para sempre, e eu serei o Deus deles."
pt.R: Eu vou dar a ti e aos teus descendentes toda a terra de Canaã, onde agora vives como estrangeiro. Ela vai ser deles para sempre, e eu vou ser o Deus deles."

am.L: ለአንተና ከአንተ በኋላ ለዘርህ መጻተኛ ሆነህ የምትኖርባትን ምድር፣ የከነዓንን ምድር ሁሉ፣ የዘላለም ርስት አድርጌ እሰጣለሁ፤ አምላካቸውም እሆናለሁ።»
am.B: አሁን መጻተኛ ሆነህ የምትኖርባትን የከነዓንን ምድር ሁሉ ለዘላለም ርስት እንድትሆን ለአንተና ከአንተ በኋላ ለዘርህ እሰጣለሁ፤ አምላካቸውም እሆናለሁ።»
am.R: አሁን እንደ እንግዳ የምትኖርባትን የከነዓንን ምድር ሁሉ ለአንተና ለዘሮችህ እሰጣለሁ። ለዘላለም የእነርሱ ትሆናለች፤ እኔም አምላካቸው እሆናለሁ።»

hi.L: और मैं तुम्हें और तुम्हारे बाद तुम्हारे वंश को तुम्हारे परदेशी होकर रहने का देश, कनान का सारा देश, सदा की निज भूमि करके दूँगा; और मैं उनका परमेश्वर रहूँगा।"
hi.B: मैं तुम्हें और तुम्हारे बाद तुम्हारे वंशजों को सारा कनान देश दूँगा, वह देश जिसमें तुम अभी परदेशी हो, कि वह सदा के लिए उनका रहे, और मैं उनका परमेश्वर रहूँगा।"
hi.R: मैं तुम्हें और तुम्हारे वंशजों को सारा कनान देश दूँगा, जहाँ तुम अभी परदेशी बनकर रह रहे हो। यह सदा उनका रहेगा, और मैं उनका परमेश्वर रहूँगा।"

ru.L: И {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} дам тебе и твоему семени после тебя землю твоего странствования, всю землю Ханаанскую, во владение вечное; и буду им Богом.»
ru.B: Я дам тебе и твоим потомкам после тебя всю землю Ханаанскую, землю, где ты сейчас пришелец, во владение навсегда, и {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} буду их Богом.»
ru.R: Я дам тебе и твоим потомкам всю землю Ханаана, где ты сейчас живёшь как чужеземец. Она будет их землёй навсегда, и {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} буду их Богом.»

uk.L: І {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} дам тобі й твоєму потомству після тебе землю твого перебування як приходька, усю землю Ханаан, у вічне володіння; і {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} буду їм Богом.»
uk.B: Я дам тобі й твоїм нащадкам після тебе всю землю Ханаан, землю, де ти тепер приходько, у володіння навіки, і {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} буду їхнім Богом.»
uk.R: Я дам тобі й твоїм нащадкам усю землю Ханаан, де ти тепер живеш як чужинець. Вона буде їхня навіки, і {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} буду їхнім Богом.»

ja.L: そしてわたしは、あなたとあなたの後の子孫に、あなたが寄留している地、カナンの全地を、永遠の所有地として与える。そしてわたしは彼らの神となる。」
ja.B: わたしは、あなたが今は寄留者として住んでいるこの地、カナンの全土を、あなたと後に続く子孫に永遠の所有地として与える。そしてわたしは彼らの神となる。」
ja.R: わたしは、あなたが今はよそ者として暮らしているカナンの土地全体を、あなたとあなたの子孫に与える。それはいつまでも子孫のものとなる。そしてわたしは彼らの神となる。」

id.L: Dan {{deity_pronoun:aku|Aku}} akan memberikan kepadamu dan kepada keturunanmu sesudah engkau negeri tempat engkau tinggal sebagai pendatang, seluruh tanah Kanaan, menjadi milik untuk selama-lamanya; dan {{deity_pronoun:aku|Aku}} akan menjadi Allah mereka."
id.B: Aku akan memberikan kepadamu dan kepada keturunanmu sesudah engkau seluruh tanah Kanaan, negeri tempat engkau sekarang menjadi pendatang, menjadi milik mereka untuk selama-lamanya, dan {{deity_pronoun:aku|Aku}} akan menjadi Allah mereka."
id.R: Aku akan memberikan seluruh tanah Kanaan, tempat kamu sekarang tinggal sebagai orang asing, kepadamu dan kepada keturunanmu. Negeri itu akan menjadi milik mereka untuk selama-lamanya, dan {{deity_pronoun:aku|Aku}} akan menjadi Allah mereka."

zh.L: 我要把你寄居之地，整个迦南地，给你和你以后的后裔，作为永久的产业；我要作他们的{{god_term:神|上帝}}。”
zh.B: 我要把整个迦南地，就是你现在作外人居住的地方，赐给你和你以后的后代，永远归你们所有；我也要作他们的{{god_term:神|上帝}}。”
zh.R: 我要把整个迦南地给你和你的后代，你现在是住在那里的外人。这地要永远属于他们，我也要作他们的{{god_term:神|上帝}}。”

tl.L: At ibibigay ko sa iyo at sa iyong binhi pagkatapos mo ang lupain ng iyong pakikipamayan, ang buong lupain ng Canaan, bilang walang hanggang pag-aari; at ako ang magiging Diyos nila."
tl.B: Ibibigay ko sa iyo at sa iyong mga inapo pagkatapos mo ang buong lupain ng Canaan, ang lupaing kung saan ka dayuhan ngayon, upang maging inyo magpakailanman, at ako ang magiging Diyos nila."
tl.R: Ibibigay ko sa iyo at sa iyong mga inapo ang buong lupain ng Canaan, kung saan ka nakatira ngayon bilang dayuhan. Magiging kanila ito magpakailanman, at ako ang magiging Diyos nila."

decisions.choice: the land of your sojournings: the land where you live as a foreigner
decisions.reason: Abraham lives in Canaan as a resident foreigner (12:10; 23:4). The land he owns none of is promised to his descendants.

decisions.choice: "lupain ng iyong pakikipamayan" (land of your sojournings) at Literal, "kung saan ka dayuhan" (where you are a foreigner) at Balanced and Readable
decisions.reason: The glossary's "nakikipamayan" for living as a resident alien (m1), as in 12:10. Balanced and Readable say "dayuhan".

source.text: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֱלֹהִים֙ אֶל־אַבְרָהָ֔ם וְאַתָּ֖ה אֶת־בְּרִיתִ֣י תִשְׁמֹ֑ר אַתָּ֛ה וְזַרְעֲךָ֥ אַֽחֲרֶ֖יךָ לְדֹרֹתָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And said God to Abraham, and you, my covenant you will keep, you and your offspring after you for their generations.

en.L: And God said to Abraham, "As for you, you shall keep {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} covenant, you and your offspring after you throughout their generations.
en.B: God also said to Abraham, "Your part is to keep {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} covenant, you and your descendants after you in every generation.
en.R: Then God said to Abraham, "You and your descendants after you must keep your part of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} covenant for all time.

es.L: Y dijo Dios a Abraham: «Y tú, guardarás {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pacto, tú y tu descendencia después de ti, por sus generaciones.
es.B: Dios también le dijo a Abraham: «A ti te toca guardar {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pacto, a ti y a tus descendientes después de ti, en cada generación.
es.R: Luego Dios le dijo a Abraham: «Tú y tus descendientes después de ti {{plural_you:deben|debéis}} cumplir {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} parte de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} promesa para siempre.

fr.L: Et Dieu dit à Abraham : « Et toi, tu garderas {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} alliance, toi et ta descendance après toi, au long de leurs générations.
fr.B: Dieu dit encore à Abraham : « Ta part, c’est de garder {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} alliance, toi et tes descendants après toi, de génération en génération.
fr.R: Ensuite Dieu a dit à Abraham : « Toi et tes descendants après toi, vous devrez toujours faire votre part pour garder {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} promesse.

sw.L: Mungu akamwambia Abrahamu, "Nawe, utalishika agano {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}}, wewe na uzao wako baada yako katika vizazi vyao.
sw.B: Mungu akamwambia pia Abrahamu, "Sehemu yako ni kulishika agano {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}}, wewe na wazao wako baada yako katika kila kizazi.
sw.R: Kisha Mungu akamwambia Abrahamu, "Wewe na wazao wako baada yako lazima mtimize sehemu yenu ya ahadi {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} milele.

vi.L: Đức Chúa Trời lại phán với Áp-ra-ham: "Còn con, con phải giữ giao ước của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, con và dòng dõi con sau con, qua các thế hệ của họ.
vi.B: Đức Chúa Trời cũng phán với Áp-ra-ham: "Phần con là phải giữ giao ước của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, con và dòng dõi con sau con, đời này qua đời kia.
vi.R: Rồi Đức Chúa Trời phán với Áp-ra-ham: "Con và con cháu con sau này phải luôn giữ phần mình trong giao ước của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.

ko.L: 그리고 하나님께서 아브라함에게 말씀하셨다. "너로 말하자면, 너는 내 언약을 지켜야 한다. 너와 네 뒤에 오는 네 씨가 그들의 대대로 [지켜야 한다].
ko.B: 하나님께서 또 아브라함에게 말씀하셨다. "너는 내 언약을 지켜야 한다. 너와 네 뒤를 이을 자손이 대대로 지켜야 한다.
ko.R: 하나님께서 또 아브라함에게 말씀하셨다. "너와 네 뒤에 올 자손은 내 언약에서 너희가 할 일을 영원히 지켜야 한다.

pt.L: E Deus disse a Abraão: "Quanto a ti, guardarás a {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} aliança, tu e a tua descendência depois de ti, através das suas gerações.
pt.B: Deus disse ainda a Abraão: "A tua parte é guardar a {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} aliança, tu e os teus descendentes depois de ti, em todas as gerações.
pt.R: Depois Deus disse a Abraão: "Tu também deves fazer a tua parte na {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} promessa, tu e os teus descendentes depois de ti, para sempre.

am.L: እግዚአብሔርም አብርሃምን አለው፦ «አንተም ቃል ኪዳኔን ጠብቅ፤ አንተና ከአንተ በኋላ ዘርህ በትውልዳቸው።
am.B: እግዚአብሔርም አብርሃምን እንዲህ አለው፦ «የአንተ ድርሻ ቃል ኪዳኔን መጠበቅ ነው፤ አንተና ከአንተ በኋላ ዘርህ በየትውልዱ ጠብቁት።
am.R: ከዚያም እግዚአብሔር አብርሃምን እንዲህ አለው፦ «አንተና ከአንተ በኋላ የሚመጡት ዘሮችህ በቃል ኪዳኔ ውስጥ ያላችሁን ድርሻ ለዘላለም መጠበቅ አለባችሁ።

hi.L: और परमेश्वर ने अब्राहम से कहा, "और तुम, तुम मेरी वाचा का पालन करना, तुम और तुम्हारे बाद तुम्हारा वंश, उनकी पीढ़ी-पीढ़ी में।
hi.B: परमेश्वर ने अब्राहम से यह भी कहा, "तुम्हारी ओर से यह है कि तुम मेरी वाचा का पालन करो, तुम और तुम्हारे बाद तुम्हारे वंशज, हर पीढ़ी में।
hi.R: फिर परमेश्वर ने अब्राहम से कहा, "तुम्हें और तुम्हारे बाद तुम्हारे वंशजों को सदा तक मेरी प्रतिज्ञा में अपना भाग निभाना है।

ru.L: И сказал Бог Аврааму: «А ты храни {{deity_pronoun:мой|Мой}} завет, ты и твоё семя после тебя в их поколениях.
ru.B: И ещё Бог сказал Аврааму: «А твоё дело — хранить {{deity_pronoun:мой|Мой}} завет, тебе и твоим потомкам после тебя во всех поколениях.
ru.R: Потом Бог сказал Аврааму: «Ты и твои потомки после тебя всегда должны хранить {{deity_pronoun:мой|Мой}} завет со своей стороны.

uk.L: І сказав Бог Авраамові: «А ти — ти бережи {{deity_pronoun:мій|Мій}} завіт, ти і твоє потомство після тебе в їхніх поколіннях.
uk.B: Бог сказав також Авраамові: «Твоя справа — берегти {{deity_pronoun:мій|Мій}} завіт, тобі й твоїм нащадкам після тебе в кожному поколінні.
uk.R: Потім Бог сказав Авраамові: «Ти і твої нащадки після тебе завжди повинні виконувати свою частину {{deity_pronoun:моєї|Моєї}} обіцянки.

ja.L: そして神はアブラハムに言われた。「あなたについては、あなたはわたしの契約を守らなければならない。あなたとあなたの後の子孫は、代々にわたって。
ja.B: 神はまたアブラハムに言われた。「あなたの側では、わたしの契約を守りなさい。あなたも、後に続くあなたの子孫も、代々にわたって守るのである。
ja.R: それから神はアブラハムに言われました。「あなたとあなたの子孫は、いつまでも、この契約のうちあなたがたの側の務めを果たさなければならない。

id.L: Dan Allah berfirman kepada Abraham, "Dan engkau, engkau harus memegang perjanjian-{{deity_pronoun:ku|Ku}}, engkau dan keturunanmu sesudah engkau turun-temurun.
id.B: Allah berfirman pula kepada Abraham, "Bagianmu ialah memegang perjanjian-{{deity_pronoun:ku|Ku}}, engkau dan keturunanmu sesudah engkau di setiap angkatan.
id.R: Lalu Allah berfirman kepada Abraham, "Kamu dan keturunanmu sesudah kamu harus menepati bagianmu dalam perjanjian-{{deity_pronoun:ku|Ku}} untuk selama-lamanya.

zh.L: {{god_term:神|上帝}}又对亚伯拉罕说：“至于你，你要守我的约，你和你以后的后裔，世世代代[都要守]。
zh.B: {{god_term:神|上帝}}又对亚伯拉罕说：“你的责任是守我的约，你和你以后的后代，代代都要如此。
zh.R: {{god_term:神|上帝}}又对亚伯拉罕说：“你和你以后的后代必须永远遵守我的盟约中你们该做的部分。

tl.L: At sinabi ng Diyos kay Abraham, "Ikaw naman, tutuparin mo ang aking tipan, ikaw at ang iyong binhi pagkatapos mo sa kanilang mga salinlahi.
tl.B: Sinabi pa ng Diyos kay Abraham, "Ang iyong bahagi ay ang tuparin ang aking tipan, ikaw at ang iyong mga inapo pagkatapos mo sa bawat salinlahi.
tl.R: Pagkatapos ay sinabi ng Diyos kay Abraham, "Ikaw at ang iyong mga inapo pagkatapos mo ay dapat tumupad sa inyong bahagi sa aking tipan magpakailanman.

decisions.choice: as for you, you shall keep my covenant: Abraham's part

source.text: זֹ֣את בְּרִיתִ֞י אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּשְׁמְר֗וּ בֵּינִי֙ וּבֵ֣ינֵיכֶ֔ם וּבֵ֥ין זַרְעֲךָ֖ אַחֲרֶ֑יךָ הִמּ֥וֹל לָכֶ֖ם כָּל־זָכָֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: This [is] my covenant which you will keep between me and you and your offspring after you: will be circumcised to you every male.

en.L: This is {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} covenant, which you shall keep, between {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} and you and your offspring after you: every male among you shall be circumcised.
en.B: Here is the covenant you and your descendants are to keep with {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}: every male among you is to be circumcised.
en.R: This is what you must do to keep {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} covenant: every boy and man among you must be circumcised.

es.L: Este es {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pacto, que {{plural_you:guardarán|guardaréis}}, entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} y yo y tu descendencia después de ti: todo varón entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} será circuncidado.
es.B: Este es el pacto que {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} y tus descendientes {{plural_you:deben|debéis}} guardar conmigo: todo varón entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} será circuncidado.
es.R: Esto es lo que {{plural_you:deben|debéis}} hacer para cumplir {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} promesa: todos los niños y hombres que haya entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} deben ser circuncidados.

fr.L: Voici {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} alliance, que vous garderez, entre {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} et vous et ta descendance après toi : tout mâle parmi vous sera circoncis.
fr.B: Voici l’alliance que vous garderez avec {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, toi et tes descendants : tout mâle parmi vous devra être circoncis.
fr.R: Voici ce que vous devez faire pour garder {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} promesse : chaque garçon et chaque homme parmi vous doit être circoncis.

sw.L: Hili ndilo agano {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}} mtakalolishika, kati {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} na ninyi na uzao wako baada yako: kila mwanamume kwenu atatahiriwa.
sw.B: Hili ndilo agano mtakalolishika pamoja {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}}, wewe na wazao wako: kila mwanamume miongoni mwenu atatahiriwa.
sw.R: Hiki ndicho mnachopaswa kufanya ili kutimiza ahadi {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}: kila mvulana na kila mwanamume miongoni mwenu lazima atahiriwe.

vi.L: Đây là giao ước của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} mà các con phải giữ, giữa {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} với con và dòng dõi con sau con: mọi người nam trong các con phải chịu cắt bì.
vi.B: Đây là giao ước con và dòng dõi con phải giữ với {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}: mọi người nam trong các con đều phải chịu cắt bì.
vi.R: Đây là điều các con phải làm để giữ giao ước của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}: mọi bé trai và đàn ông trong các con đều phải chịu cắt bì.

ko.L: 너희가 지켜야 할 내 언약, 곧 나와 너희와 네 뒤에 오는 네 씨 사이의 [언약은] 이것이다. 너희 가운데 모든 남자는 할례를 받아야 한다.
ko.B: 너와 네 뒤를 이을 자손이 나와 맺고 지켜야 할 언약은 이것이다. 너희 가운데 모든 남자는 할례를 받아야 한다.
ko.R: 내 언약을 지키려면 너희가 해야 할 일이 있다. 너희 가운데 남자는 아이든 어른이든 모두 할례를 받아야 한다.

pt.L: Esta [é] a {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} aliança, que vocês guardarão, entre {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}} e vocês e a tua descendência depois de ti: todo homem entre vocês será circuncidado.
pt.B: Esta é a aliança que deverás guardar {{deity_pronoun:comigo|Comigo}}, tu e a tua descendência depois de ti: todo homem entre vocês será circuncidado.
pt.R: Isto é o que vocês têm de fazer para cumprir a {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} promessa: todos os meninos e homens entre vocês têm de ser circuncidados.

am.L: በእኔና በእናንተ መካከል፣ ከአንተም በኋላ በዘርህ መካከል የምትጠብቁት ቃል ኪዳኔ ይህ ነው፤ ከእናንተ ወንድ ሁሉ ይገረዝ።

hi.L: मेरी वाचा, जिसका पालन तुम्हें मेरे और तुम्हारे और तुम्हारे बाद तुम्हारे वंश के बीच करना है, यह है: तुममें से हर एक पुरुष का ख़तना किया जाए।
hi.B: जिस वाचा का पालन तुम्हें और तुम्हारे वंशजों को मेरे साथ करना है, वह यह है: तुममें से हर पुरुष का ख़तना किया जाए।
hi.R: मेरी प्रतिज्ञा को निभाने के लिए तुम्हें यह करना है: तुम्हारे बीच हर लड़के और हर पुरुष का ख़तना किया जाए।

ru.L: Вот {{deity_pronoun:мой|Мой}} завет, который вы будете хранить, между {{deity_pronoun:мной|Мной}} и вами и твоим семенем после тебя: да будет обрезан у вас всякий мужчина.
ru.B: Вот завет, который вы и твои потомки должны хранить со {{deity_pronoun:мной|Мной}}: каждый мужчина у вас должен быть обрезан.
ru.R: Вот что вы должны делать, чтобы хранить {{deity_pronoun:мой|Мой}} завет: каждый мальчик и мужчина среди вас должен быть обрезан.

uk.L: Це {{deity_pronoun:мій|Мій}} завіт, який ви берегтимете, між {{deity_pronoun:мною|Мною}} і вами і твоїм потомством після тебе: нехай буде обрізаний у вас кожен чоловічої статі.
uk.B: Ось завіт, якого ти і твої нащадки маєте дотримуватися зі {{deity_pronoun:мною|Мною}}: кожен чоловічої статі серед вас має бути обрізаний.
uk.R: Ось що ви мусите робити, щоб дотримуватися {{deity_pronoun:моєї|Моєї}} обіцянки: кожен хлопчик і чоловік серед вас має бути обрізаний.

ja.L: これが、わたしとあなたがた、またあなたの後の子孫との間で、あなたがたが守るべきわたしの契約である。あなたがたのうちの男子は皆、割礼を受けなければならない。
ja.B: あなたがたと後に続く子孫が、わたしとの間で守るべき契約はこうである。あなたがたの中の男子は皆、割礼を受けなければならない。
ja.R: 契約を守るためにあなたがたがしなければならないのは、このことである。あなたがたの中の男の子と男の人は、みな割礼を受けなければならない。

id.L: Inilah perjanjian-{{deity_pronoun:ku|Ku}} yang harus kalian pegang, antara {{deity_pronoun:aku|Aku}} dan kalian dan keturunanmu sesudah engkau: setiap laki-laki di antara kalian harus disunat.
id.B: Inilah perjanjian yang harus kalian pegang dengan-{{deity_pronoun:ku|Ku}}, engkau dan keturunanmu: setiap laki-laki di antara kalian harus disunat.
id.R: Inilah yang harus kalian lakukan untuk menepati perjanjian-{{deity_pronoun:ku|Ku}}: setiap anak laki-laki dan laki-laki dewasa di antara kalian harus disunat.

zh.L: 这就是你们要守的、在我与你们以及你以后的后裔之间的约：你们中间所有的男子都要受割礼。
zh.B: 这就是你和你的后代要与我守的约：你们中间所有的男子都要受割礼。
zh.R: 你们要守我的盟约，就必须这样做：你们中间所有的男孩和男人都要受割礼。

tl.L: Ito ang aking tipan, na inyong tutuparin, sa pagitan ko at ninyo at ng iyong binhi pagkatapos mo: tutuliin ang bawat lalaki sa inyo.
tl.B: Ito ang tipang inyong tutuparin sa akin, ikaw at ang iyong mga inapo: tutuliin ang bawat lalaki sa inyo.
tl.R: Ito ang dapat ninyong gawin upang tuparin ang aking tipan: tutuliin ang bawat batang lalaki at lalaki sa inyo.

decisions.choice: circumcised: the cutting away of the foreskin
decisions.reason: Circumcision was practiced by other peoples of the region, but here it is given a new meaning: the sign of belonging to God's covenant people.

decisions.choice: {{plural_you:guardarán|guardaréis}}, entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}
decisions.reason: From here to verse 13 the Hebrew "you" turns plural ("you will keep", "among you"): the command is given to Abraham and his household and descendants together, so Spanish moves from "tú" to the plural forms, under the plural you setting, while "tu descendencia" stays singular as in the Hebrew.

decisions.choice: mtakalolishika, kwenu / miongoni mwenu
decisions.reason: From here to verse 13 the Hebrew "you" turns plural ("you will keep", "among you"), so Swahili moves to the plural prefix "m-" and "ninyi", "-enu", while "uzao wako" stays singular as in the Hebrew.

decisions.choice: "cắt bì", "phép cắt bì" for circumcise and circumcision
decisions.reason: As the Genesis terms note sets, and as the Vietnamese Acts 7:8 and Romans 4 say. The foreskin itself is "da bao quy đầu" (L, B, R in 17:11).

decisions.choice: "할례를 받다" for being circumcised, "할례를 행하다" for circumcising another (17:23; 21:4)
decisions.reason: "할례" is the established Korean word, used for this covenant in Acts 7:8; the next verse says what it is, so the plain word can stand from the start.

decisions.choice: vocês (to Abraham with his descendants)
decisions.reason: From here to verse 13 the Hebrew turns to the plural: God speaks to Abraham and all the males of his household and line. Portuguese follows it with "vocês", God's address to a group (docs/pentateuch-portuguese-terms.md), and keeps "tu" where the Hebrew speaks to Abraham alone ("a tua descendência").

decisions.choice: "ख़तना"
decisions.reason: The established word for circumcision, as Acts 7:8, which retells this covenant ("ख़तने की वाचा").

decisions.choice: "обрезан", "обрезание"
decisions.reason: The established Russian word, as in Acts 7:8 and Romans 4:11 in this translation.

decisions.choice: "обрізати", "обрізання" at every level
decisions.reason: The word of Acts 7:8 and Romans 4, kept the same through Genesis 17, 21 and 34.

decisions.choice: circumcise: "割礼を受ける" (every level)
decisions.reason: The Japanese word for the rite, used in the NT drafts (Galatians, Titus); Readable keeps it and 17:11 says what it is.

decisions.choice: you plural: "あなたがた" (every level in God's speech here)
decisions.reason: God turns from Abraham to his household; あなたがた at L and B by the style guide, kept at R because God is speaking (みなさん would make the speech polite).

decisions.choice: "disunat" for circumcised; "kalian" for the plural you
decisions.reason: "sunat" is the ordinary Indonesian word for circumcision (m1), used by church and Islamic usage alike, so it is kept at every level. The Hebrew changes here from "you" singular to plural, which Indonesian marks with "kalian".

decisions.choice: "受割礼" (be circumcised); "行割礼" (circumcise)
decisions.reason: The glossary's words, the church's shared vocabulary, at every level; the foreskin is "包皮".

decisions.choice: "tutuliin" (shall be circumcised)
decisions.reason: "tuliin" is the glossary word, the cutting away of the foreskin (m1). The custom is known to every Filipino reader.

source.text: וּנְמַלְתֶּ֕ם אֵ֖ת בְּשַׂ֣ר עָרְלַתְכֶ֑ם וְהָיָה֙ לְא֣וֹת בְּרִ֔ית בֵּינִ֖י וּבֵינֵיכֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And you will be circumcised [in] the flesh of your foreskin, and it will be a sign of [the] covenant between me and you.

en.L: You shall be circumcised in the flesh of your foreskins, and it shall be a sign of the covenant between {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} and you.
en.B: You are to cut away the flesh of your foreskin, and it will be the sign of the covenant between {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} and you.
en.R: You must cut off the foreskin of your bodies. This will show that you belong to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} and that I have made this covenant with you.

es.L: Y {{plural_you:serán|seréis}} circuncidados en la carne de {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} prepucio, y será señal del pacto entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} y yo.
es.B: {{plural_you:Deberán|Deberéis}} cortar la carne del prepucio, y esa será la señal del pacto entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} y yo.
es.R: {{plural_you:Tienen|Tenéis}} que cortarse el prepucio. Así se verá que {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} {{plural_you:pertenecen|pertenecéis}} y que yo {{plural_you:les|os}} he hecho esta promesa.

fr.L: Et vous serez circoncis dans la chair de votre prépuce, et ce sera le signe de l’alliance entre {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} et vous.
fr.B: Vous couperez la chair de votre prépuce, et ce sera le signe de l’alliance entre {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} et vous.
fr.R: Vous devez vous faire couper le prépuce. Cela montrera que vous {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}appartenez et que je vous ai fait cette promesse.

sw.L: Nanyi mtatahiriwa katika nyama ya govi lenu, na hiyo itakuwa ishara ya agano kati {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} na ninyi.
sw.B: Mtakata nyama ya govi lenu, nayo itakuwa ishara ya agano kati {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} na ninyi.
sw.R: Lazima mkatwe govi la miili yenu. Hilo litaonyesha kwamba ninyi ni watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, na kwamba nimewapa ahadi hii.

vi.L: Các con phải chịu cắt bì nơi thịt bao quy đầu, và điều đó sẽ là dấu hiệu của giao ước giữa {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} và các con.
vi.B: Các con phải cắt bỏ da bao quy đầu, và đó sẽ là dấu hiệu của giao ước giữa {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} và các con.
vi.R: Các con phải cắt bỏ da bao quy đầu trên thân thể mình. Điều đó sẽ cho thấy các con thuộc về {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã lập giao ước này với các con.

ko.L: 너희는 너희 포피의 살을 베어 할례를 받아야 한다. 그것이 나와 너희 사이의 언약의 표징이 될 것이다.
ko.B: 너희는 포피의 살을 베어야 한다. 그것이 나와 너희 사이에 맺은 언약의 표징이 될 것이다.
ko.R: 너희는 몸의 포피를 잘라 내야 한다. 그것은 너희가 내게 속했고 내가 너희와 언약을 맺었다는 것을 보여 주는 표가 될 것이다.

pt.L: Vocês serão circuncidados na carne do prepúcio, e isso será um sinal da aliança entre {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}} e vocês.
pt.B: Vocês cortarão a carne do prepúcio, e esse será o sinal da aliança entre {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}} e vocês.
pt.R: Vocês têm de cortar fora o prepúcio do corpo. Isso vai mostrar que vocês pertencem a {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}} e que eu fiz esta promessa a vocês.

am.L: የሸለፈታችሁንም ሥጋ ትገረዛላችሁ፤ ይህም በእኔና በእናንተ መካከል የቃል ኪዳን ምልክት ይሆናል።
am.B: የሸለፈታችሁን ሥጋ ትቆርጣላችሁ፤ ይህም በእኔና በእናንተ መካከል ያለው የቃል ኪዳን ምልክት ይሆናል።
am.R: የሰውነታችሁን ሸለፈት መቁረጥ አለባችሁ። ይህም የእኔ መሆናችሁንና ይህን ቃል ኪዳን ከእናንተ ጋር እንደ ገባሁ ያሳያል።

hi.L: तुम अपनी खलड़ी के मांस का ख़तना करना, और वह मेरे और तुम्हारे बीच वाचा का चिह्न होगा।
hi.B: तुम अपनी खलड़ी का मांस काट देना, और यह मेरे और तुम्हारे बीच की वाचा का चिह्न होगा।
hi.R: तुम्हें अपने शरीर की चमड़ी काट देनी है। इससे पता चलेगा कि तुम मेरे हो और मैंने तुमसे यह प्रतिज्ञा की है।

ru.L: И обрезывайте плоть вашей крайней плоти, и это будет знаком завета между {{deity_pronoun:мной|Мной}} и вами.
ru.B: Вы должны обрезать свою крайнюю плоть, и это будет знаком завета между {{deity_pronoun:мной|Мной}} и вами.
ru.R: Вы должны отрезать крайнюю плоть на своём теле. Это будет знак того, что вы принадлежите {{deity_pronoun:мне|Мне}} и что {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} заключил с вами завет.

uk.L: І ви обріжете плоть вашої крайньої плоті, і це буде знаком завіту між {{deity_pronoun:мною|Мною}} і вами.
uk.B: Ви маєте обрізати свою крайню плоть, і це буде знаком завіту між {{deity_pronoun:мною|Мною}} і вами.
uk.R: Ви мусите обрізати крайню плоть на своєму тілі. Це показуватиме, що ви належите {{deity_pronoun:мені|Мені}} і що {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} дав вам цю обіцянку.

ja.L: あなたがたは包皮の肉に割礼を受けなければならない。そしてそれが、わたしとあなたがたとの間の契約のしるしとなる。
ja.B: あなたがたは包皮の肉を切り取らなければならない。それが、わたしとあなたがたとの間の契約のしるしとなる。
ja.R: あなたがたは、体の包皮を切り取らなければならない。それが、あなたがたがわたしのものであり、わたしがこの契約を結んだしるしとなる。

id.L: Kalian harus disunat pada daging kulit khatan kalian, dan itulah yang akan menjadi tanda perjanjian antara {{deity_pronoun:aku|Aku}} dan kalian.
id.B: Kalian harus memotong daging kulit khatan kalian, dan itulah tanda perjanjian antara {{deity_pronoun:aku|Aku}} dan kalian.
id.R: Kalian harus memotong kulit khatan kalian. Itulah tanda bahwa kalian milik-{{deity_pronoun:ku|Ku}} dan bahwa {{deity_pronoun:aku|Aku}} telah mengadakan perjanjian ini dengan kalian.

zh.L: 你们要在你们包皮的肉上受割礼，这要作为我与你们之间的约的记号。
zh.B: 你们要割去包皮，这要作为我与你们之间的约的记号。
zh.R: 你们必须割掉身上的包皮。这要表明你们属于我，表明我与你们立了这盟约。

tl.L: Tutuliin kayo sa laman ng inyong balat ng masama, at iyon ay magiging tanda ng tipan sa pagitan ko at ninyo.
tl.B: Tutuliin ninyo ang laman ng inyong balat ng masama, at iyon ang magiging tanda ng tipan sa pagitan ko at ninyo.
tl.R: Dapat ninyong tuliin ang inyong mga katawan. Ipakikita nito na kayo ay sa akin at na ginawa ko ang tipang ito sa inyo.

decisions.choice: a sign of the covenant: as the rainbow was for Noah
decisions.reason: As the bow was the sign of the covenant with Noah (9:12-17), circumcision is the sign of the covenant with Abraham, carried in the body. Later scripture calls for circumcision of the heart as well (Deuteronomy 10:16; Romans 2:28-29).

decisions.choice: "balat ng masama" (foreskin); "tanda ng tipan" (sign of the covenant)
decisions.reason: "balat ng masama" is the established Tagalog Bible term for the foreskin. "tanda" is the sign, as the rainbow was for Noah (9:12-13, m1).

source.text: וּבֶן־שְׁמֹנַ֣ת יָמִ֗ים יִמּ֥וֹל לָכֶ֛ם כָּל־זָכָ֖ר לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶ֑ם יְלִ֣יד בָּ֔יִת וּמִקְנַת־כֶּ֨סֶף֙ מִכֹּ֣ל בֶּן־נֵכָ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֛ר לֹ֥א מִֽזַּרְעֲךָ֖ הֽוּא׃

records.literal_gloss: And a son of eight days will be circumcised to you, every male, for your generations, one born in [the] house and one bought with silver from any foreigner, who [is] not of your offspring.

en.L: At eight days old every male among you shall be circumcised, throughout your generations, whether born in your household or bought with silver from any foreigner who is not of your offspring.
en.B: Every male among you who is eight days old must be circumcised, generation after generation, including slaves born in your household or bought with money from a foreigner who is not one of your descendants.
en.R: From now on, every baby boy must be circumcised when he is eight days old. This includes the boys and men who are slaves in your household, whether they were born there or bought from foreigners.

es.L: A los ocho días de nacido, todo varón entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} será circuncidado, a lo largo de {{plural_you:sus|vuestras}} generaciones, tanto el nacido en [tu] casa como el comprado con plata a cualquier extranjero que no sea de tu descendencia.
es.B: Todo varón entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} que tenga ocho días debe ser circuncidado, generación tras generación, incluidos los esclavos nacidos en tu casa o comprados con dinero a un extranjero que no es de tu descendencia.
es.R: Desde ahora, todo niño debe ser circuncidado cuando tenga ocho días. Esto incluye a los niños y hombres que sean esclavos en tu casa, tanto los que nacieron allí como los que compraste a extranjeros.

fr.L: Et à l’âge de huit jours, tout mâle parmi vous sera circoncis, au long de vos générations, celui qui est né dans la maison et celui qui a été acheté à prix d’argent à tout étranger qui n’est pas de ta descendance.
fr.B: Tout mâle parmi vous sera circoncis à l’âge de huit jours, de génération en génération, y compris les esclaves nés dans ta maison ou achetés avec de l’argent à un étranger qui n’est pas de ta descendance.
fr.R: Désormais, chaque petit garçon devra être circoncis quand il aura huit jours. Cela concerne aussi les garçons et les hommes qui sont esclaves dans ta maison, qu’ils y soient nés ou que tu les aies achetés à des étrangers.

sw.L: Na mwenye umri wa siku nane atatahiriwa kwenu, kila mwanamume katika vizazi vyenu, aliyezaliwa nyumbani na aliyenunuliwa kwa fedha kutoka kwa mgeni yeyote asiye wa uzao wako.
sw.B: Kila mwanamume miongoni mwenu atatahiriwa akiwa na siku nane, kizazi hata kizazi, pamoja na watumwa waliozaliwa nyumbani mwako au walionunuliwa kwa fedha kutoka kwa mgeni asiye wa uzao wako.
sw.R: Tangu sasa, kila mtoto wa kiume lazima atahiriwe akiwa na siku nane. Hili linawahusu pia wavulana na wanaume walio watumwa nyumbani mwako, wawe walizaliwa humo au uliwanunua kutoka kwa wageni.

vi.L: Mọi người nam trong các con, khi được tám ngày, phải chịu cắt bì, qua các thế hệ của các con, dù sinh ra trong nhà hay được mua bằng bạc từ bất cứ người ngoại quốc nào không thuộc dòng dõi con.
vi.B: Mọi bé trai trong các con được tám ngày phải chịu cắt bì, từ đời này sang đời kia, kể cả các nô lệ sinh ra trong nhà hay được mua bằng tiền từ người ngoại quốc không thuộc dòng dõi con.
vi.R: Từ nay về sau, mọi bé trai phải chịu cắt bì khi được tám ngày. Điều này cũng áp dụng cho các bé trai và đàn ông làm nô lệ trong nhà các con, dù họ sinh ra ở đó hay được mua từ người nước ngoài.

ko.L: 너희 가운데 모든 남자는 너희 대대로 난 지 팔 일 만에 할례를 받아야 한다. 집에서 난 자든, 네 씨가 아닌 이방 사람에게서 은으로 산 자든 [그러하다].
ko.B: 너희 가운데 남자는 대대로 모두 난 지 여드레 만에 할례를 받아야 한다. 너희 집에서 태어난 종이나, 너희 자손이 아닌 이방 사람에게서 돈을 주고 산 종도 마찬가지이다.
ko.R: 이제부터 모든 사내아이는 태어난 지 여드레째 되는 날에 할례를 받아야 한다. 너희 집에서 일하는 종들도 그렇게 해야 한다. 집에서 태어난 종이든, 다른 나라 사람에게서 사 온 종이든 모두 받아야 한다.

pt.L: Com oito dias de idade, todo homem entre vocês será circuncidado, através das suas gerações, o nascido em casa e o comprado com prata de qualquer estrangeiro que não seja da tua descendência.
pt.B: Todo menino entre vocês será circuncidado aos oito dias de idade, geração após geração, incluídos os escravos nascidos em casa ou comprados com dinheiro de algum estrangeiro que não é da tua descendência.
pt.R: De agora em diante, todo menino tem de ser circuncidado quando tiver oito dias de vida. Isso vale também para os meninos e homens que são escravos na tua casa, tanto os que nasceram ali como os que foram comprados de estrangeiros.

am.L: በትውልዳችሁ ሁሉ ከእናንተ የስምንት ቀን ወንድ ሁሉ ይገረዝ፤ በቤት የተወለደም ሆነ ከዘርህ ካልሆነ ከማንኛውም ባዕድ በብር የተገዛ።
am.B: ከእናንተ መካከል የስምንት ቀን የሆነው ወንድ ሁሉ በየትውልዱ ይገረዝ፤ በቤትህ የተወለዱትንና ከዘርህ ካልሆነ ባዕድ በገንዘብ የተገዙትን ባሪያዎች ጨምሮ።
am.R: ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ ወንድ ሕፃን ሁሉ በተወለደ በስምንተኛው ቀን መገረዝ አለበት። ይህም በቤተሰባችሁ ውስጥ ባሪያዎች የሆኑትን ወንዶች ልጆችና ሰዎች ይጨምራል፤ በዚያ የተወለዱም ሆኑ ከባዕዳን የተገዙ።

hi.L: और तुम्हारी पीढ़ी-पीढ़ी में तुममें से हर एक पुरुष का, आठ दिन का होने पर, ख़तना किया जाए, चाहे वह घर में जन्मा हो, या किसी विदेशी से चाँदी देकर मोल लिया गया हो जो तुम्हारे वंश का नहीं है।
hi.B: पीढ़ी-पीढ़ी तक तुममें से हर पुरुष का आठ दिन का होने पर ख़तना किया जाए, उन दासों का भी जो तुम्हारे घराने में जन्मे हों, या किसी ऐसे विदेशी से पैसे देकर ख़रीदे गए हों जो तुम्हारे वंश का नहीं है।
hi.R: अब से हर लड़के का ख़तना आठ दिन का होने पर किया जाए। इसमें वे लड़के और पुरुष भी शामिल हैं जो तुम्हारे घराने में दास हैं, चाहे वे वहीं जन्मे हों या विदेशियों से ख़रीदे गए हों।

ru.L: И сын восьми дней да будет обрезан у вас, всякий мужчина в ваших поколениях, рождённый в доме и купленный за серебро у всякого чужеземца, который не от твоего семени.
ru.B: Каждый мальчик у вас в восьмой день после рождения должен быть обрезан, из поколения в поколение, в том числе рабы, рождённые в доме или купленные за деньги у чужеземца, который не из твоих потомков.
ru.R: Отныне каждого мальчика нужно обрезать, когда ему исполнится восемь дней. Это касается и мальчиков и мужчин, которые у вас рабы, родились ли они в вашем доме или были куплены у чужеземцев.

uk.L: І восьмиденного обрізуйте у вас кожного чоловічої статі в ваших поколіннях — і народженого в домі, і купленого за срібло в будь-якого чужинця, який не з твого потомства.
uk.B: Кожен чоловічої статі серед вас, коли йому мине вісім днів, має бути обрізаний, з покоління в покоління, разом із рабами, народженими в домі чи купленими за гроші в чужинця, що не з твоїх нащадків.
uk.R: Відтепер кожного немовляти-хлопчика треба обрізати, коли йому буде вісім днів. Це стосується й рабів у вашому домі — і тих, хто народився в ньому, і тих, кого купили в чужинців.

ja.L: あなたがたのうちの男子は皆、代々にわたって、生まれて八日目に割礼を受けなければならない。家で生まれた者も、あなたの子孫ではない外国人から銀で買い取られた者も[同様である]。
ja.B: あなたがたの中の男子は皆、代々にわたって、生まれて八日目に割礼を受けなければならない。家で生まれた奴隷も、あなたの子孫ではない外国人から代価を払って買い取った奴隷も同じである。
ja.R: これから後、男の赤ちゃんはみな、生まれて八日目に割礼を受けなければならない。あなたの家にいる奴隷の男の子や男の人も同じだ。家で生まれた者も、外国人から買い取った者もそうである。

id.L: Pada umur delapan hari setiap laki-laki di antara kalian harus disunat, turun-temurun, baik yang lahir di rumahmu maupun yang dibeli dengan perak dari orang asing mana pun yang bukan keturunanmu.
id.B: Setiap laki-laki di antara kalian yang berumur delapan hari harus disunat, turun-temurun, termasuk budak yang lahir di rumahmu atau yang dibeli dengan uang dari orang asing yang bukan keturunanmu.
id.R: Mulai sekarang setiap bayi laki-laki harus disunat ketika berumur delapan hari. Ini juga berlaku bagi anak laki-laki dan laki-laki dewasa yang menjadi budak di rumah tanggamu, baik yang lahir di sana maupun yang dibeli dari orang asing.

zh.L: 你们中间每一个男子，世世代代，生下来第八天都要受割礼；无论是在家里生的，还是用银子从不是你后裔的任何外族人那里买来的。
zh.B: 你们中间所有满八天的男子都要受割礼，世世代代都要这样，包括家里生的奴隶，或用钱从不是你后代的外族人那里买来的奴隶。
zh.R: 从现在起，每个男孩出生第八天都要受割礼。这也包括你们家中作奴隶的男孩和男人，无论是在家里出生的，还是从外族人那里买来的。

tl.L: Sa ikawalong araw ay tutuliin ang bawat lalaki sa inyo, sa inyong mga salinlahi, maging ipinanganak sa inyong sambahayan o binili ng pilak sa sinumang dayuhan na hindi mula sa iyong binhi.
tl.B: Dapat tuliin ang bawat lalaki sa inyo na walong araw na ang gulang, sa bawat salinlahi, pati ang mga aliping ipinanganak sa inyong sambahayan o binili ng salapi sa isang dayuhan na hindi mo inapo.
tl.R: Mula ngayon ay dapat tuliin ang bawat sanggol na lalaki pagsapit ng ikawalong araw niya. Kasama rito ang mga batang lalaki at mga lalaking alipin sa inyong sambahayan, ipinanganak man sila roon o binili sa mga dayuhan.

decisions.choice: eight days old: the set time for circumcision
decisions.reason: The rule is kept in the law of Moses (Leviticus 12:3) and in the New Testament (Luke 1:59; 2:21).

decisions.choice: born in the household or bought: the covenant includes the whole household
decisions.reason: Slaves of the household, foreigners by birth, receive the sign too. Belonging to the covenant was never only a matter of descent.

decisions.choice: slaves
decisions.reason: "Slaves" in Readable and Balanced, as the style guide keeps it for people bought with money (m2).

decisions.choice: "ባሪያዎች" (slaves) for those born in the household or bought with money
decisions.reason: As the Pentateuch's Amharic sets for people bought and sold: these are slaves, and the English Balanced and Readable say so; "አገልጋይ" would hide that they were property.

decisions.choice: "विदेशी" for the foreigner (ben nekhar)
decisions.reason: "परदेशी" is kept for the sojourner (ger), as the Pentateuch note has it; the man from another nation who sells a slave is "विदेशी". The same in 17:27.

decisions.choice: "奴隶" at Balanced and Readable
decisions.reason: The English says "slaves" for people born in the household or bought with money, where slavery itself is the point; the glossary keeps 奴隶 then at every level.

decisions.choice: "sa ikawalong araw" (at eight days old); "binili ng pilak" (bought with silver)
decisions.reason: The set time for circumcision (m1). The covenant includes the whole household, slaves too (m2); Balanced and Readable say "alipin" (en1).
